subtitle: Desktop Hyper Stack & Site Welcome Soundtrack
changes: Moved the PC HYPER MUSIC floating launcher above the Founder avatar on the right, retaining both mobile top-of-website header positions unchanged.
Added a configurable first-party welcome soundtrack at assets/nexus-intro.mp3, which the site recognizes after the owner uploads their licensed MP3 through the repository.
Desktop attempts welcome-track playback on startup when browser autoplay policy permits, with a manual fallback when sound is blocked; mobile uses an explicit one-tap start in the website header.
Hosted welcome audio uses the existing music player without creating a second competing player or modifying locally saved playlists, builds, account data or backups.
Added owner-only soundtrack upload guidance and static regression checks; the actual MP3 upload and live browser autoplay verification remain outstanding.
